prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1145; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly. Our client was injured in a low-speed head-on collision and is entitled to a full and fair evaluation of the claim.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage limits of every policy that may apply to the insured driver and owner of the vehicle involved, together with a copy of the declarations page for each policy.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes vehicle and telematics data, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, repair and total-loss records, and any electronic communications. Routine destruction or alteration of this material should be suspended until the claim is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written confirmation of receipt and of the steps taken in response to this letter.
